book.name: LUCAS
book.title: SAN LUCAS Maach peerdʉ aaujem Jesucristo igwia jöoi Lucaau phã pʉatarr

content: Jesús pʉr awaag ibëptarr
Mag ãbmiecha Jesús ich khapeen dʉ̈i Jerusalén phöbör ee nʉm jaar, pan levadura chukhu wauwia khoojem phiesta burrju khãai khapan khaba waaur sĩejim aajem. Ich mag phiestapai ĩchab Pascua a thʉ̈ʉrjem.

Maagwai ĩchab phadnaan ee chi pörkha nʉm khʉʉnau agjö judionaan Ẽwandam iek athee chi machnaan dʉ̈imua amach eepai, “Jãgata akhiin bʉ̈ʉrjã õrag khaugpiba jãg Jesús pʉrnaa thõobpʉ̈ikhamgui” anaajim anʉm. “Magba mʉg khapanag eewe pʉr athaawai eeu õor pöm mʉg thʉnʉm maach dʉ̈ita meeukhadukham” a khĩirju naajim aajem.

Amau mag khĩirju nʉm ee, woun ãb Judas a thʉ̈r sim sĩejim aajem, ibʉʉr wauwia ĩchab Iscariote a thʉ̈ʉrjerr. Mag woun ĩchab ich Jesús dʉ̈i i bʉ̈ ogdʉba wënʉrraajerr khʉʉn eem ajim aajem. Mag Jesús dʉ̈i ãba nʉrraajerrta meperau pör meubaadeewai phadnaan chi pörkha nʉm khʉʉn dʉ̈i ĩchab guardianaanjã chi pörkha nʉm khʉʉnpa ãba nʉm aar majim anaabá, jãgata ichdëu amag i pʉr deeju khap jawaan.
Maimua barimawia jaaubaawai, amachdëu chi Judas iek amach jʉ̈gaagaa ũrbaawai, oneeu phöbaadëwia warag irig phatkhonjã deeju a iekhajierram aajem.

Ichig magbaawai chará warag, —Ich magau magan maach iekhabarm; murua chadcha pãrag i pʉr deejugui ajim anʉm. Magtarr aigmua ãba i pʉr deeju khĩirjugta wai sĩsijim aajem, chi phöbörpienagjã ich khaugpiba.
Ãbmiecha Jesús ich khapeen dʉ̈i thach khötarr
Judaau Jesús ëugar mamagkham ee, pan levadura chukhu wauwia khoojem ed ãspa ëebaadëjim aajem. Mag ed judionaanau nemkhoo edam athee ovejadam wai narr thõowia edau khëubaadeewai khoojeejim aajem.
Ich mag edcha Jesuu Pedro dʉ̈i Juan thʉ̈rkhanaa amag magjim anʉm: —Pãar maar na ërëubaadët. Maimua ovejadam për auwia agdamta maar na phiejãb waubaimat ajim anʉm, maach thum ãba khöimaag.
Magbaawai amachdëu, —¿Jampaita marau pʉ na phiejãb wauwimaju aai nʉma? a jëeujierram aajem Jesuug.

Magbaa chi Jesuu amag, —Chamʉg Jerusalenag khʉd ma sim ee ërëubaadët ajim anʉm. Nau chi phöbör dub nʉm aigcha woun ãb dö jöi authurwia döthũr dʉ̈i degag mam pãrau ooimaju. Magbaawai i dʉ̈i ërëuwia i dubbaimam deg dʉ̈i dubbaimat ajim anʉm.
Mag dubwia chi dikhʉʉg, mʉch chi maestroouta pãar pʉ̈ijim abat, jampaita nau kheeurag maach thum ãba thach khöju aai nʉ a khap jëeumkhĩir.
Magbaawai mag wounau pãrag oopien majugui ajim anʉm, ʉ̈gthaa dijã pöm sim ya sĩi chi khĩir khaugam. Maigta nem thum khĩir khaugwia maar nʉbat ajim aajem.

Magbaawai chadcha i ipierraa ërëubaadeeu thum ichdëu jaaumarrjöo ooimajierram anaabá. Maig, ich na mag ovejadam waupitarr chadcha tagam nempa thum khĩir khaugwia sĩi tagam khʉʉn dʉ̈i i baraata oo nʉisijim aajem, ãba khoog.

Maimua khëubaadëm ee Jesús barchëjim aajem, tagam khʉʉn ich khapeen dʉ̈i, Pedro Juan dʉ̈i narr aig. Mag ichdëu jʉr auwia i dʉ̈i ogdʉba wënʉrraajerr khʉʉn deeu thumaa nʉisim ee, ya chi phiejãb wau wai narrjã thöikha sĩsiewai ãba khoog paaukhabaadëjim aajem.
Mag khö nʉmua magjim aajem ich khapeenag: —Keena, chadcha chikhamnaanau juau mʉch thõoju nawe pãar dʉ̈i mʉg nemkhoo edam ovejadam khöm khõchaaga chirajimgui ajim anʉm.

Mʉ chan mʉg khöbarm aigmua tag khöba, ãba Ẽwandamta ʉ̈gthar thumaam khʉʉn Pörkha sĩsim edta ũmaai pãar dʉ̈i ãba tagam khʉʉn ichdëu peerdʉ autarr khʉʉnpa deeu maach thum ãba khöjugui ajim anʉm. Mag edta thumaam khʉʉnau warrgar nemkhoo edam oveja thõowai Ẽwandamau amach peerdʉ auju a khĩirjuajerrjö, chadcha amach peerdʉ nʉisim khaphʉ ajugui ajim anʉm.
Maimua vino jarrdam jua ee auwia Ẽwandamag ʉ̈u ajim anaa, —Ya pʉr athat ajim anʉm. Maimua, Dönaa jũrr ʉapʉ̈ipetat ajim anʉm, agdaujö dö aumamkhĩir.
Mʉʉn ãbmieta ĩs pãar dʉ̈i mʉg vinodam dö chirʉmgui ajim anʉm. Mʉg döbarm aigmua tag döba, ãba Ẽwandamta thumaam khʉʉn Pörkha sĩsim edta deeu döjugui ajim aajem.
Maimua agjö panjã jua ee auwia, Ẽwandamag ʉ̈u ajim anaa, thorreuwia, amag deenaa, —Mʉg panan mua mʉch morta pãrag dee chirʉm; mʉg atagjã mʉ khĩirjunaa ich mʉgta khabat a jaaujim aajem.

Maimua ya khö aaipagkhabaadëm ee, deeu chi vino jarrdam jua ee auwia ĩchab, —Mʉg jarr eem vinodam döbarmta warrgarwe Ẽwandamau õor dʉ̈i iek deeju aajerrau; mamʉ mʉg iekhan iek iiuriugui ajim anʉm. Mʉ bag mʉg vinojö ãrbarmuata Ẽwandamau, ĩsmua atagan chadau pãar peerdʉ wënʉrraju aai nʉm a jaau simgui ajim anʉm.
Pãrag khap amkhĩir warre jaau chirʉmgui ajim anʉm: Mag mʉ bag ãrmkhĩran, maach eem mʉig maach dʉ̈i ãba thach khö simuapaita ich paarmua mʉ pʉr deeju, mʉ oomapham khʉʉnag.

Mʉʉn chadcha Emkhooi Iewaau, mamʉ magʉm ãba chadcha amau mʉ thõojugui ajim anʉm. Mamʉ Ẽwandamau ich magpiju arr aawai thum ichdëu jaautarrjöo öbëbërgmam. Mamʉ ¡Ë, apkhiitʉ ajim anʉm, mag mʉ thõomkhĩir mʉ pʉr dee chirʉm woun!
Jesús mag iekhabarm ũrwia i khapeenau amach eepai jũrr chikham ipeer ahaukhamua, —¿Chijãguataa wir aigpai mag meer i pʉr deeju khai? anaajim anaabá.
Ẽwandam dau na khaita ʉ̈rʉʉcha sim khai
Maimua nʉʉpai awia ĩchab amach eepai, “¿Chijãata magan mʉig maach ee ʉ̈rʉʉcha sĩ?” a chikham ipeer ahau khaphöbaadëjim aajem.

Mamʉ magbaawai Jesuu amag magjim anʉm: —Mʉg durr gaai reinaan thʉnʉm khʉʉnan amachta ʉ̈rʉʉcha nʉm awia õor dʉ̈i athuucha sĩerrjëem. Mamʉ mag nʉmta amachta chi thierrnaan awia jũrr õrag amach igwia, “Jãguan chadau maar athee nem ajaphamta waaujem” a iekhapimjã khõsi aajemgui ajim anʉm.
Mamʉ pãar ee magju aai khaba nʉmgui ajim anʉm. Mag khãyau chadcha thethem awia khãijã warag serbiibamjöta aju aai sim; maagwai chi pörkha simta jũrr ich chogjöta aju aai simgui ajim anʉm.

Magnaa amag, Pãrau khĩirjuawai, ¿chijã chi thethem agá ajim anʉm: sĩi mes gaai thöikha sĩsiewai khoogpai jupcheejem, wa mes gaai chi thëp paajem? Magnaa ichdëupai, Chi ʉ̈rʉʉcha simʉn ya sĩi thöikha sĩsim abaawai khoogpai jupcheejemʉugui ajim anʉm. Magnaa amag, Mʉʉn chadcha pãar Pöröugui ajim anʉm. Mamʉ pãrau oo nʉm, sĩi mʉig mʉ pãar chogkha chitʉmjöo chirʉm.
Mamʉ mua ĩchab khaphʉ chirʉmgui ajim anʉm, chadcha pãarta mʉ dʉ̈i ogdʉba ich jãg wënʉrraajem mʉ chitʉmpierr, pãach dau aphʉʉ ajujã khĩirjuba.
Pãach jãg wënʉrrʉm gaaimua, mua pãrag ĩchab mʉch dʉ̈i õor pörkhapijugui ajim anʉm, mʉ Ayau mʉchta thumaam khʉʉn reikhapibarm dʉ̈i.

Mag mʉchta thumaam khʉʉn Pörkha chirsim edta deeu maach ãba onee aju. Maimua rey juupjemjöm sie gaai jupkhawia pãachta mʉ dʉ̈i jöoi Jacob khararr chaain doce narr khʉʉn ag chaain ewagam khʉʉn pörkhajugui ajim anʉm.
Jesuu jaauwai Pedroou bʉ̈ʉrjã i khaugbam aju jaautarr
Maimua ĩchab magjim aajem maach Pör Jesuu Simonag: —Simón, dösãtau Ẽwandamag jëeu wai simgui ajim anʉm, pʉ dʉ̈i ichdëu ampierr awia pʉ dau aug waupieg.

Mamʉ mua jũrr pʉ kõit Ẽwandamag jëeu chirʉmgui ajim anʉm, pʉch khũgurcheewai warre burrm iek burrm ugua. Maagwai ũmaai deeu mʉ thʉ̈r gaai khĩirju chirsiewai pʉchdëupaita jũrr pʉch khapeenag jaauju aai chirʉmgui ajim anʉm, amjã agjö ubʉ nʉisimkhĩir.
Magbaawai chi Simonau irig, —Señor, mʉʉn pʉ dʉ̈i cárcel deg mawia pʉ thõbarm aar thõimaju akhiinjã maju chirʉm; magʉmjã mʉ gaai mas khabamgui ajim anʉm.
Magbaawai Jesuu jũrr irig, —Pedro ajim anʉm, pʉ mag iekha chirʉm ãba, nau õrau pʉchig jëeuwai, ãthãrr bĩeju nawe biek thãrjup purua amag bʉ̈ʉrjã mʉ khaugba chitʉm a jaaujugui ajim anʉm.
Espaar numí

Maimua warm khʉʉnagjã magjim aajem: —Ar mua Ẽwandam iek jawamkhĩir pãar putjã chukhu phatkhonjã chukhu sĩi ich jãg zapat theg jũajujã chukhu pʉ̈ijim ed, ¿nem inag athee pãar augchëjierrá? ajim anʉm. Magbaawai chi khapeenau, —Ʉ̈ʉ̈, bʉ̈ʉrjã maar augchëbajimgui ajierram aajem.

Magbaawai deeu ichdëupai amag, —Magtarr ĩsin chadau put wai nʉm khai, athaadët; ĩchab phatkhon khãijã wai nʉm khai, athaadët; maimua ãb khãijã espaar chukhu sim khai, ich khajũa përbapʉ̈i ajim anʉm, agua awaag.

Mua pãrag mag chirʉmʉn, Ẽwandam iek phã sim gaai jaau simjö ya mʉch thõimʉʉ paawaita mag chirʉmgui ajim anʉm. Ẽwandam iek phã sim gaai mʉ igwia jaauwai, “Iin, õor thõomiejöta wai naaju” a sim. Mʉ igwia ich mag phã sim aawai chadcha thum ichdëu jaau sim eyaa öbëbërg maju a jaaumajim aajem.
Magbaawai amachdëu irig oopinaa, —Señor, ya marau mʉig espaar numí wai nʉmgui ajierram anʉm. Magbaawai ichdëu, —Tag mʉ iekhabam, idëu ich magpai sĩujugui ajim.
Nemjĩirdö Getsemaní anʉm ee Jesús oraatarr
Maigmua öbërdʉtkhaau Jesús Olivo durrsĩig petajim aajem, kheeupierr mawia mag durrsĩ gaaimua ich Ayag jëeujerr aawai. Mag i mam dʉ̈i ĩchab i khapeenjã i dʉ̈i wëtjim aajem.
Mag wëtwia ich Ayag jëeujem aig bardʉtkhabaimaawai ich khapeenag, —Ẽwandamag jëeubat ajim anʉm, dösãtag ʉdʉraa pãach phũrreu aupiba mʉ dʉ̈ita ubʉ wënʉrraag.
Mag jaauwia, ichin am aigmua mawia, juau mokdau barbapäaiwai burrjem ag warphagjöpai sĩeimajim aajem, am bigaau. Maig jẽkhʉt jĩepöröu phõbkhanaa, ʉ̈gthaag eerpanaa, ich Ayag jëeubaadëjim aajem.

Mag jëeumamua, —Tata ajim anʉm, pua khõs akhiin, atcha mʉ dau aphʉʉ apibakham. Deeum nem waubarmuajã agjö õor peerdʉ auju ayaa akhiin, mʉ gaai machag mʉgcha ãwatbakhamgui aajeejim anʉm. Mamʉ pʉchdëuta khap chirʉm; mʉchdëu khõsi chirʉmjö khaba, pʉchdëu khõchagpierrta mʉ dʉ̈i abá a iekhamajim aajem.
[Ich Ayag jëeuwai mamagkhamua kha theeg chukhu thʉnʉm ee, ʉ̈gtharmua Ẽwandam chog bëewia irig juapá deechëjim aajem, mag ich dau aphʉʉ aju ãwatamkhĩir.

Mag ich dau aphʉʉ aju khĩirjuwia gaai machag thʉnʉmua warag oraa nʉmta, khajapham nemjö thet phʉrëu ahau aajeejim anʉm. Mamagkhamua jʉachë thʉnʉm oowain sĩi jʉa gaai bagpata öbër thʉnʉm thëutkha thʉnaajim anaabá.]
Mag ʉ̈gthaag ich Ayag jëeu sĩi awia, phiidʉwia, ich khapeen oon bëewai sĩi warag ökhĩirjug machgau khãidʉtkha thʉnʉmta oochëjim anʉm.
Magbaawai amag, —Phiidʉtkhabathʉ̈ keena ajim anʉm. ¿Khantheeta pãar khãi nʉma? Khãiju khãai Ẽwandamagta jëeubathʉ̈ ajim anʉm, dösãtag ʉdʉraa pãach thʉ aupim ugua.
Jesús pʉr arrtarr

Mamʉ agtha Jesús mag iekha dʉnʉm ee, dëgölp am aig õor khapan pos aichëjim anaabá. Mag khapanag ee oowai ich Jesús dʉ̈i doce ogdʉba wënʉrraajerr eem ãb Judas a thʉ̈r sĩerrta am na urajim anʉm. Mag bëewia, Jesús dʉ̈i ãba dʉnʉʉuchëjim anaabá, sĩi khajapha saludaa nʉmjö i khĩir ʉ̈ʉg.
Magbaawai Jesuu irig magjim anʉm: —Judas, mʉch chi Emkhooi Iewaa mʉ oomapham khʉʉnag pʉr deeg mʉ khĩir ʉ̈ʉ chirʉmta pʉchigan sĩi saludaa chirʉm a chirabma ajim anʉm.
Magbaawai ich Jesús khapeenau amach Pör dau aphʉʉ aju khaug athaawai, —Kakë, ¿marau pʉ kõit esparau am dʉ̈i jãauju jãg nʉ? ajierram anʉm irig.
Mag irig jëeu nʉm ee, ãbmua bis abarmʉn, phadnaan pör ag chog kach juachaar garmta warre oorthubapʉ̈ijim anaabá.
Magbaawai Jesuu ich khapeenag, —Oob jãgmiet; idëu mʉ dʉ̈i amachdëu ampierr apibat ajim anʉm. Magnaa chi kach deeu ich sĩerrjöo khaarpi sĩujim anaabá.

Maimua Jesuu oowai aig naajim aajem: phadnaan chi pörkha nʉm khʉʉn, judionaan Asamblea eem pörnaan, maimua Ẽwandam i jëeujem di thʉajem khʉʉn chi pörnaanpa thʉnaajim aajem, i pʉr awaan bëetarr khʉʉn. Magbaawai chi Jesuu amag magjim aajem: —¿Pãrau oowain mʉʉn sĩi õor nem jĩgkhanaa õor thõomiejöta chirabama ajim anʉm, jãg sĩi mʉ aig jua ee jierrnempan appai bëeg?

Ẽwandamag jëeujem deg ed ëepierr pãar dʉ̈i mʉ chiraawai, bʉ̈ʉrjã pãrau mʉ chig aba aajerrta, ĩsta Ẽwandamau pãrag ʉdʉraa mʉ pʉr aupiju ed ajim. Maagwai ĩsta ĩchab chi dösãtjã pãar ʉ̈rpaju ed ajimgui ajim anʉm, mʉ pʉr aumkhĩir.
Pedroou Jesús khaugba chitʉm atarr
Maimua Jesús pʉrphöbaadëwia, arrwia, phadnaan pör deg wai dubphöbaadëjim aajem. Maagwai Pedroou warppaimuata i ẽudee oopʉ̈pʉ̈ig warrmaa ajim anaabá.
Mag chi phadnaan pör aar deethurwia chi Jesús ierr wai nʉmich, jũrr di ũjãrr õt örwia ag bigaau ohood aphöbaadëjim aajem. Magbaawai Pedrojã ĩchab am bigaau oo sĩsijim anʉm.
Mamʉ i mag oo simta, aiguim ʉʉi ĩchab chi phadnaan pör chogkha sim bëewia, i khĩir eerpanaa, warm khʉʉnag, —Chamʉg wounjã ĩchab i dʉ̈i nʉrraajemʉu aichëjim anʉm.
Magbaawai Pedroou, —Mua magʉm wounaan ooba chitʉmgui ajim anʉm.
Maimua ag khur nʉʉpai awia jũrr emkhooi ãbmua irig, —Pʉjã am eem khabahab aichëjim anʉm. Magbaawai Pedroou, —Kakë, mʉ chan am eem khabam perá ajim anʉm.
Maimua deeu ag khur ora ãbjönaa deeum bëewia maguajã agjö irig, —Chadcha mʉg wounjã i dʉ̈i nʉrraajem khabahab ajim anʉm; jãan Galileapierrauwai ajim anʉm.
Magbaawaita Pedroou, —Kakë, mua bʉ̈ʉrjã khaugbam, khan ata pʉ iekha chirʉm khai ajim anʉm. Magbarm bʉ̈rre agtha thumjã Pedro iekha öba nʉm ee, ãthãrrta kekerekee ahbar.

Mag ãthãrr bĩebaawai maach Pör Jesucristoou ewag phʉʉrba oo nʉʉ ajim aajem, Pedroog. Maigta Pedroou khĩir eyaa aadëjim anaabá, maach Pöröu ichig, “Pedro, ãthãrr bĩeju nawe õrau pʉchig jëeuwai biek thãrjup pua bʉ̈ʉrjã mʉ khaugba chitʉm a iekhaju” a jaautarr.
Mag khĩir ee dʉnʉisim abarmʉn chadau, gaai machaaga aadëmua dawag öbërwia, warre ö jãsenag aadëmua bĩe sĩi ajim anaabá.
Jesús dau aphʉʉ wai narr
Maagwai Jesús pʉr wai nʉm aig oopaar thʉnarr khʉʉnaujã i wau iekhanaa ĩchab moketaupa phãr wai nʉmua i gaai mas waumaajeejim aajem.
Magnaa putiu i dau phãarjʉ̈naa jũrram khʉʉnau khĩidadcha juajãau phot anaa irig, —Magan khaug athá, khaíuta pʉ phãrjĩ aajeejim anʉm.
Ich mag pʉamjã igba, i wau wai nʉmua warag irig parhoobajã iekhamaajeejim aajem.
Jesús judionaan Asamblea ee wai narr
Maimua ya ãspabaadeewai ãba biirdʉjierram aajem: Asamblea eem chi pörnaan phadnaan pörkha nʉm khʉʉn dʉ̈i Ẽwandam i jawaag chi machnaanpa. Mag biirdʉwia amach Asamblea ee chi Jesús aibëewia irig,

—¿Pʉchta chadcha warrgarwe Ẽwandamau õor peerdʉ aumkhĩir jʉr auwia pʉ̈iju aajerrá? Warre marag jaaubá ajierram anʉm, marau khap aag. Magbaawai Jesuu, —Mua pãrag jaaukhiinjã, pãrau mʉ iek ʉ̈khabajugui ajim anʉm.
Maimua mʉch garmua jũrr pãrag jëeumakhiinjã, pãrau mʉ iek jʉ̈ʉjã aba ni mʉ pʉapʉ̈ijã pʉapʉ̈ibajugui ajim anʉm.
Mamʉ nau mʉg atag jöpcha mʉg woun Emkhooi Iewaa Ẽwandam chi jua thierr bigaau i juachaar gar jupimajugui ajim anʉm, Ẽwandam dʉ̈i ãba thumaam khʉʉn Pörkhaag.
Magbaawai thumaam khʉʉnau irig, —¿Ãa, magan pʉʉn Ẽwandam Iewaapama? ajierram anʉm. Magbaawai jũrr ichdëu amag, —Pãachdëupa khabá pãrau khaphʉ mʉ aruu a jaau nʉmgui ajim anʉm.
Magbaawaita amachdëu, —¿Khan atcha maadëu deeum khʉʉnau jaau nʉmta ũrm ig nʉma? Ya maadëu ũrbarmgui ajierram anʉm, ich iiucha jaaubarm.
